places.name: Arunachaleswarar Temple
places.blurb: A massive historic Shiva temple at the base of the sacred Annamalai Hills, famous for its towering gopurams.

places.name: Gingee Fort
places.blurb: One of the most impenetrable hill forts in India, often called the Troy of the East by the British.

places.name: Vellore Fort
places.blurb: A stunning 16th-century granite fortress surrounded by a wide moat and housing the historic Jalakandeswarar Temple.

places.name: Kailasanathar Temple
places.blurb: The oldest structure in Kanchipuram, showcasing magnificent Pallava architecture and sandstone carvings.

places.name: Ekambareswarar Temple
places.blurb: A vast temple complex in the temple city of Kanchipuram, famous for its ancient mango tree and towering gopuram.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: An experimental universal township dedicated to human unity, famous for the golden sphere of the Matrimandir.

places.name: Yercaud
places.blurb: A charming and peaceful hill station in the Shevaroy Hills known for its pleasant climate, coffee plantations, and big lake.

places.name: Skandashramam
places.blurb: A serene cave dwelling high on the hill where Ramana Maharshi spent several years in meditation.

places.name: Hogenakkal Falls
places.blurb: Often referred to as the Niagara of India, known for its picturesque waterfalls and exhilarating coracle boat rides.
